title: hawk-eco compatibility matrix
description: Schema for compatibility-matrix.json — records which combinations of component versions are tested together.

version.description: Schema version of this file (independent of any component version).

components.description: Canonical list of component (repo) names in the eco.

dependencies.description: Per-component dependency list — which other eco components a given one consumes. Drives test ordering and impact analysis.

matrices.description: Named version combinations that are tested together.

components.description: Map of component name → version. Use `main` to mean the latest commit on the main branch (tested every PR).
